info.description:
This documentation is exclusively for the ArcheryHub Mobile Application.
NOTE: This Swagger only contains endpoints relevant to mobile app workflows (Scoring, Events, and Auth).
info.title: ArcheryHub Mobile API

get.description: Returns the authenticated archer cart items

post.description: Creates orders and Tripay payment from authenticated archer cart

get.description: Returns all events the authenticated archer has registered for
Returns archer QR information and payment status for a specific event
Returns registration details including payment status and payment instructions
get.summary: Get archer's registration for an event

get.description: Returns authenticated archer order history with payment summary

post.description: Create Tripay payment transaction for archer registration in an event
Login for archers using email and password
Login for organizations using email and password
Login for scorekeepers using their unique code
Login for sellers using email and password

get.description: Lists archer/seller conversations including last message, unread counters, and last seen info

post.description: Archer starts (or gets existing) conversation with seller, optionally by product

get.description: Returns message list in a conversation and marks opposite side unread as read

post.description: Sends a message to a conversation as archer or seller participant

get.description: Returns last_seen_at and online flag for chat peer (seller or archer)
Returns total unread chats for current archer/seller

post.description: Calculate winner from scores and finish the match
Mark a match as finished and advance winner to next round
Reset a finished match back to in_progress and remove winner from next round
Update or create end scores for a match

get.description: Get published events for mobile with pagination and search
Get event detail (by slug or UUID) with the same response body as /events/:id
Returns active products for mobile marketplace read-only pages
Returns one product by UUID or slug for mobile marketplace read-only pages
get.summary: Get marketplace product detail for mobile

get.description: Returns published news list for mobile read-only pages
Returns one published news article by UUID or slug
get.summary: Get published news detail for mobile

get.description: Get selectable target cards for scoring context

post.description: Update end scores for an assignment (supports batch)

get.description: Get scoring progress for a selected target in a session
